notes: The track is often muddy. Wear boots.
You must book the huts and campsites in all months.
Kiwi are active near the huts after dark. Use a red light, keep quiet and stay 5 m away.

northarm.name: North Arm Hut and Campsite
northarm.note: DOC hut and campsite. 4 tent sites. You must book before you go. Facilities: heating, mattresses, non-flush toilets. Boil the water before you drink it.

maoribeach.name: Māori Beach Campsite
maoribeach.note: DOC campsite. 4 tent sites. You must book before you go. Facilities: fire place, non-flush toilets. Boil the water before you drink it.

portwilliamhut.name: Port William Hut and Campsite
portwilliamhut.note: DOC hut and campsite on a side track of about 40 minutes from the junction. You must book before you go. An old sawmill and settlement site.

start.name: Oban
start.note: The town at Halfmoon Bay. The ferry from Bluff takes about 1 hour. The track starts with a road walk to Lee Bay.

end.name: Oban
end.note: End of the circuit, after a road walk from Fern Gully.

pois.name: Lee Bay
pois.text: The entrance to Rakiura National Park. The chain sculpture is the anchor chain of the canoe of Māui: Te Punga o Te Waka a Māui.

pois.name: Māori Beach sawmill
pois.text: A sawmill worked here until 1931. A steam boiler from the mill is in the bush behind the beach.
